# Vinca Wealth

> Vinca Wealth is a research-driven wealth management firm in Bengaluru (Bangalore), Karnataka, India. It is an AMFI registered mutual fund distributor (ARN-293401) that helps families across India plan for retirement and financial freedom through goal-based mutual fund investing, portfolio monitoring and insurance planning.

- Company: Vinca Wealth (CIN U65999KA2022PTC169569)
- Registration: AMFI Registered Mutual Fund Distributor, ARN-293401; Insurance POSP Code 1726204591
- Location: Electronic City, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560100, India. Meetings in person in Bengaluru, or online for clients elsewhere in India and NRIs.
- Contact: +91-7386809164, support@vincawealth.com
- Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks. Read all scheme related documents carefully.

## What Vinca Wealth does

- [Retirement planning](https://vincawealth.com/#services): Financial Freedom Readiness (FFR) score, retirement corpus estimation, SIP strategy and timeline, retirement date projection.
- [Mutual fund portfolio management](https://vincawealth.com/#services): goal-based portfolio construction, SIP setup and management, regular rebalancing and performance tracking.
- [Insurance planning](https://vincawealth.com/#services): life insurance adequacy check, health insurance review and coverage gap identification.
- [Financial Freedom Calculator](https://vincawealth.com/financial-freedom-calculator): free tool to estimate your retirement corpus, gap and retirement date.

## Research and articles

- [Blog](https://vincawealth.com/blog): data-backed articles on mutual funds, SIPs, markets, retirement planning and personal finance in India.
- [Sitemap](https://vincawealth.com/sitemap.xml): every published article.
